sentence: Minh likes cats, and he doesn't like dogs.
ruleVi: Hai ý trái ngược nhau nối bằng but.

sentence: Lan is sad but her cat is sick.
ruleVi: Nêu lý do dùng because + mệnh đề.

sentence: Do you want tea but coffee?
ruleVi: Đưa ra lựa chọn dùng or.

sentence: Minh eats a lot of phở or he is very hungry.
ruleVi: Nêu lý do dùng because + mệnh đề.

sentence: My house is small or very nice.
ruleVi: Hai ý trái ngược (small – nice) nối bằng but.

sentence: I have a dog but a cat.
ruleVi: Thêm một ý cùng chiều dùng and.

sentence: Lan doesn't go to school today but she is sick.
ruleVi: Nêu lý do dùng because + mệnh đề.

sentence: He can sing, because he can't dance.
ruleVi: Hai ý trái ngược (can – can't) nối bằng but.

sentence: I want to be a doctor because of I like helping people.
ruleVi: Trước một mệnh đề (I like...) dùng because, không dùng because of.

sentence: Hanoi is cold in winter because hot in summer.
ruleVi: Hai ý trái ngược (cold – hot) nối bằng but.
